lines.t: (Intro)
Before the stars were set in motion,
Before the tides obeyed the ocean,
You were there in quiet flame,
Speaking life without a name.
(Verse 1)
You stretched the sky with just a word,
Every galaxy has heard.
Mountains rise and oceans bow,
Yet You’re here beside me now.
And all my striving fades away,
When I remember who You are.
(Pre-Chorus)
The same hand that holds the night,
Calls me into rest and light.
(Chorus)
You are greater than it all,
Every star and every fall.
Yet You meet me in the pause,
In the stillness of it all.
On this sacred, quiet day,
All my burdens drift away.
In Your presence I remain,
Held inside unending grace.
(Verse 2)
Time itself is in Your hands,
Yet You tell my heart to stand—
Not in labor, not in fear,
But in knowing You are near.
Every breath and every beat,
Finds its rhythm at Your feet.
(Pre-Chorus 2)
I don’t have to chase the wind,
You have always pulled me in.
(Chorus)
You are greater than it all,
Every rise and every fall.
Yet You meet me in the pause,
In the stillness of it all.
On this holy, set-apart day,
You restore what fades away.
I lay down my need to strive,
In Your rest I come alive.
(Bridge)
The heavens echo, the earth replies,
Your glory stretches through all time.
(Build)
And still You whisper, “Come be still,”
Beyond the noise, beyond my will.
(Drop)
The infinite… in quiet close,
The One who holds me most.
(Final Chorus)
You are greater than it all,
Endless, faithful, standing tall.
Yet You meet me when I fall,
In the stillness of it all.
On this Sabbath, I am free,
From the weight of needing to be.
You are everything I need,
In Your rest, my soul can breathe.
(Outro)
Let the world keep spinning fast,
I have found a peace that lasts.
In the silence, I can see—
The One who made eternity…
Is resting here with me.
